entities.summary: Aidarus Qassem Abdulaziz Al-Zubaidi is a Yemeni politician who served as chairperson of the Southern Transitional Council from 2017, and was Vice President of the Presidential Leadership Council (PLC) from 2022 to 2026. He previously served as the governor of Aden Governorate from December 2015 to April 2017.
